pr_title: ddl: support scatter region when create table with split single region
pr_body:
<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/55184 ref https://github.com/tikv/pd/issues/8424

Problem Summary: Enable `split-table`, create table without other options(such as partitions, `pre_split_regions` ), TiKV only will split one region. If enable `tidb_scatter_region`, PD will compare the region count record by `engineContext` in https://github.com/tikv/pd/blob/13174b5d4cab4d958f0b4ea2718ea7bb74992bc7/pkg/schedule/scatter/region_scatterer.go#L444. 

Since in first time call scatter region, all region count is 0 in `engineContext`. So it will pick the origin store. IOW, `tidb_scatter_region` doesn't work when there is only one region in table/group level. For these table, scatter region in cluster level.

### What changed and how does it work?
1. Set `tableID` to nil. All new table with only one region will be the same group in PD. Add  `scatterRegionByClusterLevel` in `SplitRecordRegion()` decide `tableID` is nil or not. 
2. Add `scatter` in `preSplitAndScatter()`

since the pr base on PD schedule(include RPC server and scatter region), UT is hard to cover. Add test in PD is better.
